_comment: B' (2026-10-21): configs/miniarc_pe_rule.json with the LTD threshold initialised open (1e-4 instead of 1e-3). At initialisation on Mini-ARC (LTD off) a block writes entries of |R - R0| with median 4e-4 (25th percentile 1.6e-4), so 1e-3, applied every block, zeroed most of them; in B at step 2328 theta was still 1e-3 (0.96-1.00e-3), 49% of R - R0 was 0 after the first block and 78% at the last, median 0 from block 15 on. The write gate is kept (bias -2): at step 2328 it was selective through its weights (mean w 0.15, std over tokens 0.22, 13% of tokens above 0.5), and with the update normalised by 1 + sum w a bias of 0 would only flatten that. Last block with gradients kept. Everything else as B.
